results.detail: Becoming is discoverable in the authenticated House directory.
Local preference schema accepts Becoming in Here · Now and survives reload.
House opens /becoming in-app and the ambient House MAIA handle is suppressed.
In-journey MAIA receives only current journey/element context through its explicit guide act.
Post-Return MAIA receives the whole journey and conversation remains inside Becoming.
Across Time uses the dedicated selected-context MAIA lane and carries the differentiated-gestalt law.
Across Time protects unsaved notes, then returns cleanly to the House after explicit discard.
